name: Rowan Konaté
location: The Underworld - B2-B12, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description: Deshi maintains the Underworld communications mesh. Neutral. The fastest fiber splicer in complete darkness.

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (48.7%) with substantial Northern European (22.0%), Central Asian (16.2%), and Eastern European (13.1%) ancestry. Complex genetic admixture resulting in warm, deep brown skin with subtle olive undertones and refined facial structure showing both African and Eurasian features.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry with developed forearms and shoulders from years of precision fiber work. Minimal body fat, efficient musculature.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle olive undertones, reflecting the African-majority heritage with undertones of Central and Eastern European ancestry. Even melanin distribution with natural richness.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, sculpted cheekbones and angular jaw reflecting mixed ancestry. Warm deep brown complexion shows minor scarring on right temple from a past cable snag. Perpetual stubble, minimal grooming beyond functionality. Fine lines around eyes from sustained concentration work.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running 3cm along right temple to hairline, smooth and old
Calluses across palms and fingertips, especially index and middle fingers of both hands, from splicer work
Small burn mark on left wrist — diameter of a soldering iron tip, approximately 2cm, pale and years-old
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Operates in complete darkness regularly, suggesting possible subcutaneous low-light enhancement or neural adaptations, but no external chrome.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate efficiency, minimal wasted motion. Hands rest in ready position. Inhabits spaces quietly, comfortable in darkness. Head tilts slightly when listening — suggests enhanced auditory processing or intense focus habit.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 working-class practicality. Dark tactical pants with multiple utility pockets, fitted black or grey merino wool base layers for temperature control in cold server rooms. Fingerless work gloves or thin tactile gloves always accessible. Worn tech-fabric jacket with Blackwire insignia patches. Comfortable steel-toed boots, scuffed from underground work. No visible jewelry except a flat black wedding band.
